name: Rain of Razors
text:
Razor-sharp slivers of metal fall from the sky. Each creature in a 20-foot burst within 60 feet takes floor((@actor.level -12/2)+9)d6 slashing damage with a basic Reflex save save against your class DC. The razors embed in all surfaces in the area, making them hazardous terrain for 1 minute. A creature that moves through this hazardous terrain takes floor((max(12,@actor.level-12)/2)+3) slashing damage for every square of the area it moves into.

---

Level (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d6 and the hazardous terrain damage increases by 1.
